semantics.definition: The rules every Eidos angle in degrees must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Say how far things turn, lean or slant in the 3D world, in degrees: the camera's head sweeps 40 degrees, a drone leans 12.

deg.description: An angle in the 3D world, in degrees, to the tenth: -360 to 360, at most one whole turn either way. Less than 0 turns the other way, as a line turning down; 0 is straight on.
